subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 3. Arrange the numbers 123, 132, 213, 231, 312, and 321 in descending order. 4. Which object is in the 7th position? 1st [ball, pacifier, ABC blocks, diaper, stacking rings, bottle, socks, duck, pram] 5. Which of these numbers has the digit 5 in the hundreds place? 325 525 357 6. Fill in the blank with <, >, or =. a. 245 ___ 241 b. 879 ___ 798 c. 654 ___ 534 d. 924 ___ 924 7. Bunty has 745 marbles, and Babloo has 763 marbles. Who has more marbles? ___ 8. Use the number line to round 294 to the nearest 10. 290 295 300 30

exercises.label: Questions 3 — descending order
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Arrange the numbers 123, 132, 213, 231, 312, and 321 in descending order.

exercises.label: Questions 4 — ordinal position
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Which object is in the 7th position?
items: row of 9 baby-item icons, labelled 1st at the ball
exercises.answer_key: The 7th item is the pair of socks. Position order verified by 300-DPI crop, counted twice: 1st ball, 2nd pacifier, 3rd ABC blocks, 4th diaper, 5th stacking-ring toy, 6th baby bottle, 7th pair of socks, 8th rubber duck, 9th pram/stroller. Both counting passes agreed (9 items, socks at position 7).

exercises.label: Questions 5 — hundreds-place digit
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Which of these numbers has the digit 5 in the hundreds place? 325 525 357
exercises.answer_key: 525 (the only one of the three with 5 as the hundreds digit)

exercises.label: Questions 7 — word problem comparison
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Bunty has 745 marbles, and Babloo has 763 marbles. Who has more marbles?

exercises.label: Questions 8 — rounding via number line
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Use the number line to round 294 to the nearest 10.
items: 294 on a number line marked 290-300, midpoint 295 highlighted
exercises.answer_key: 290 (294 is 4 units from 290 and 6 units from 300, and lies below the 295 midpoint marker, so it rounds down to 290)
